questions.stem: Which agency is responsible for establishing nationwide educational standards for surgical technologists through the Core Curriculum?
options: National Board of Surgical Technology and Surgical Assisting (NBSTSA)
questions.explanation: AST develops and publishes the Core Curriculum for Surgical Technology setting the standard curriculum for programs.

questions.stem: When laser surgery is in progress in the operating room, what type of surgical mask must all personnel wear?
options: High-filtration laser plume mask with side shields
N95 particulate respirator only without eye protection
questions.explanation: Specialized high-filtration laser masks filter particulate matter down to 0.1 microns to guard against mutagenic laser plume.

questions.stem: Which indicator is the only one that confirms sterilization was achieved?
questions.explanation: Only biological indicators (spores) prove the process killed microorganisms.

questions.stem: Which surgical instrument is a self-retaining retractor commonly used in thyroid and mastoid surgeries?
questions.explanation: The Jansen retractor is a miniature self-retaining retractor with curved prongs ideal for delicate neck or mastoid exposure.

questions.stem: The cystic artery typically branches from which major vessel?
questions.explanation: In normal anatomical distribution, the cystic artery originates from the right hepatic artery within Calot's triangle.
